subject: Renewal velocity kickoff — timeline, stakeholders, QBR windows
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ari Kumar <ari@lumina.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal velocity kickoff — timeline, stakeholders, QBR windows

Hi Ari —

Thanks for the heads-up on the upcoming renewal. We’d like to kick off a short renewal velocity plan so Lumina has a clear path for capacity, term adjustments, and the QBR cadence. High-level asks from our side: 

- Confirm target term length (12 vs 24 months) and any flexibility on phased commit.
- Baseline current monthly token throughput + expected peak scaling window next 6 months.
- Procurement timeline and any preferred DocuSign/PO flow.

Proposed internal owners (looping them here): Soojin (CS lead) to coordinate QBR and runbook; Ben (AM) to manage pricing/commit; Marissa (Solutions) to confirm technical onboarding and burst capacity.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Quick mutual-action-plan (MAP) draft by EOD Wed.
2) 30-min kickoff call to lock stakeholders and QBR windows — options in the Calendly link below.
3) Exchange procurement contact and any security paperwork early this week.

I’ve attached a very small renewal playbook (draft) and a MAP template to make the first pass quicker. If Lumina prefers a different cadence, adapt and send back.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/marcus-lin/qbr-lumina
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4532

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly.

—
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: renewal_playbook_draft.pdf (summary), proposed_MAP.xlsx (MAP template)

From: Ari Kumar <ari@lumina.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@lumina.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal velocity kickoff — timeline, stakeholders, QBR windows

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the clear checklist. Quick answers from our side: 

- Term: leaning toward 24 months but want a phased commit for Q3 burst (we expect ~2.5x traffic).
- Throughput: current baseline ~50M tokens/month, peak plan estimate 125M tokens/month (Q3). I can share a short usage export if helpful.
- Procurement: Procurement@lumina.ai is the right contact for PO/terms. We use standard DocuSign for signature; will request SOW and redlines.

We’re available for a kickoff Thurs or Friday morning PT. I’ll have our Head of Platform join if you want a technical discussion on burst strategy.

Thanks —
Ari
Head of Product, Lumina.ai
ari@lumina.ai

>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ari Kumar <ari@lumina.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Jul 2025 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal velocity kickoff — timeline, stakeholders, QBR windows

Marcus / Ben —

Thanks Ari for the details — that baseline + peak is super helpful. I pulled together a concise timeline below (first draft) to convert the MAP into calendarable milestones. Please flag anything missing.

Draft timeline (targets):
- By Fri 18 Jul: Redwood to send MAP draft and pricing scenarios (phased vs flat).
- Week of 21 Jul: Technical QBR (30–45 min) — discuss caching/burst plan, KV cache warmup, and prefix caching recommendations. Marissa to lead ops/tech portion.
- By 25 Jul: Procurement looped -> receive SOW/PO token.
- Early Aug: DocuSign window for signatures (if both legal teams align).
- 1 Sep: Targeted capacity uplift goes live (soft ramp through Sept).

Owners: Soojin (QBR cadences & internal readiness), Ben (pricing/commit), Marissa (burst ops runbook & pre-warm checklist), Marcus (deal exec).

Immediate asks for Ari / Lumina: 
- Confirm preferred kickoff slot (I see Thursday 7/17 10:00–11:00 PT or Friday 7/18 09:00–10:00 PT).
- Share the usage export CSV and procurement contract owner email.

Attached: renewal_playbook_draft.pdf (annotated), proposed_MAP.xlsx (first-pass filled). I’ll update MAP with pricing scenarios after Ben drops numbers.

Thanks —
Soojin
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

Attachments: renewal_playbook_draft.pdf, proposed_MAP.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ari Kumar <ari@lumina.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@lumina.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Jul 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal velocity kickoff — timeline, stakeholders, QBR windows

Ari —

Great, let’s lock Thursday 7/17 at 10:00 PT for the kickoff (I’ll send the calendar invite). On the call agenda: 1) confirm term & phased commit structure, 2) technical QBR checklist, 3) procurement timeline and redlines.

Ben — can you share two pricing scenarios (24m phased commit + 12m flat) by EOD today so Soojin can plug into the MAP? Marissa — please draft the ops checklist for pre-warm steps and expected ramp metrics.

I’ll open the HubSpot note and attach the MAP draft, and route DocuSign placeholders after we confirm the SOW owner.

Thanks all — see you on the call.

—
Marcus Lin
